metadata.description: A shop that finds homes for pets: it registers each pet with a Petstore API and publishes each adoption on a Kafka topic, which an audit reads back. The wiring of each environment is in shop.decorators.json.

nodes.name: Adoptions log
nodes.description: The Kafka cluster holding the adoptions topic, shared by the service and the audit.
